tast: Check compatibility between tast command and source code. I received many complaints that "tast run -build" fails by cgoMustBeDisabledToBuildTast. This made it clear that people usually sync their checkouts without upgrading the chroot (and tast command). This CL adds a check that the source code layout matches what "tast run -build" expects by comparing sourceCompatVersion defined in build/compat.go. readahead: Handle readahead() calls with length larger than 32 pages The readahead() syscall isn't fully honoring the provided |count| parameter despite the man page saying "...bytes are read up to the next page boundary greater than or equal to (offset+count)". Kernels prior to v4.10 are capping the count to 32 pages (128kb). The following commit, included in versions >= 4.10, changed it to the optimal hardware I/O size which appears to be 128 pages on Eve: https://github.com/torvalds/linux/commit/9491ae4aade6814afcfa67f4eb3e3342c2b39750 Fixing this is necessary for preloading the ARCVM system image file which after the ARCVM boot can have up to 4460 contiguous pages in core. Note that this also improves the average Chrome OS boot time as reported over 5 runs by login-prompt-visible in bootstat_summary's output by 12% on Eve. Before this change: login-prompt-visible = [ 4060, 4320, 4090, 4090, 4230 ] After this change: login-prompt-visible = [ 3420, 3770, 3700, 3690, 3690 ] BUG=b:137810150 TEST=ChromeOS boots 12% faster on Eve TEST=grep Cached /proc/meminfo doesn't grow significantly Change-Id: I41dd114a0864b509466580998d4e0dd9e21db162 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1717075 Tested-by: Philippe Liard <pliard@google.com> Commit-Ready: Philippe Liard <pliard@google.com> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Mike Frysinger <vapier@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Yusuke Sato <yusukes@chromium.org>

UPSTREAM: drm/i915/skl: Fix has_ipc on skl and document WaDisableIPC. According to Spec for SKL+: "Isochronous Priority Control. If enabled, Display sends demoted requests once the transition watermark is reached. If transition watermark is not enabled, Display sends demoted requests when the display buffer is full." The commit 'e57f1c02155f ("drm/i915/gen9+: Add has_ipc flag in device info structure")' introduced that as gen9+ but missing many SKL Skus. I believe the reason for that is Spec also mentions workarounds for SKL-ALL: "IPC (Isoch Priority Control) may cause underflows WA: Do not enable IPC in register ARB_CTL2" It seems lame to add the feature and forever disable it, but it will avoid a mistake of enabling it when we are reorganizing the feature definitions on i915_pci.c later. It will also allow us to probably extend that workaround for other platforms.
